subject.title: No migration path or warning when a model provider id is removed/renamed (openai-codex -> openai): OAuth profiles silently orphaned

question: Should this issue stay open as the narrow OpenAI/Codex auth-migration guidance tracker until the Nix-mode repair path lands, or should it be closed as implemented/superseded by current doctor repair plus related issues?
rationale: Current main has enough repair and partial diagnostic coverage to make the original wording partly obsolete, but the reporter's Nix-managed install still cannot invoke the repair path and related PRs split the responsibility across auth migration and Nix policy.

options.title: Keep Until Nix Repair Lands
options.body: Keep this issue open and linked until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95167 or an equivalent Nix-mode policy repair makes the existing auth migration reachable.

options.title: Close As Implemented On Main
options.body: Close if maintainers decide the current doctor auth-profile rewrite plus the newer legacy-provider hint fully satisfies this issue despite the separate Nix-mode blocker.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Migration Plan
options.body: Close as superseded only if maintainers designate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93180 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91352 as the canonical remaining OpenAI/Codex migration work.

recommendation.title: Keep Until Nix Repair Lands
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and linked until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95167 or an equivalent Nix-mode policy repair makes the existing auth migration reachable.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the OpenAI/Codex provider identity and auth migration boundary, with Nix policy as the remaining blocker.
